history.intraday: up to 60 trading days for entry timing when available
history.principle: levels require both large-cycle and small-cycle confirmation

support_resistance: cluster repeated daily/weekly swing highs and lows
weight recent touches but retain major 52-week pivots
prefer levels with multiple reactions and volume confirmation
treat gaps and failed breakout levels as supply/demand zones
use ATR-normalized zone width rather than single exact prices
breakout_validation: close through level, not just intraday wick
follow-through or successful retest improves quality
reject breakout when price closes back inside base with distribution volume

capitulation_reversal_long.idea: consecutive decline / crash into a low area followed by exhaustion and reclaim
signals: reclaim of prior-day high / EMA / broken support

repair_rebound_long.idea: large asymmetric recovery after a severe decline when trend repair starts
signals: room to next weekly resistance supports high reward/risk

accumulation_breakout_long.idea: sideways accumulation / volatility compression before expansion

signals: price trades above known resistance then closes back below
volume does not confirm or becomes distribution volume
break below intraday/daily support after exhaustion
higher price high with lower RSI/MACD/OBV confirmation

scoring.preference: allow aggressive entries when upside/downside asymmetry is large, but always define invalidation

risk.position_sizing: size from stop distance and fixed account-risk budget; do not size from conviction alone
avoid: entering a breakout solely because price changed a lot
ignoring earnings or event gap risk

stress_test_examples_from_prior_discussi.purpose: verify that the broad-market detector catches sudden high-volume/high-change moves even when they are not in the focused watchlist
